evals.prompt: A daily Apps Script emails overdue invoices, but rerunning after a timeout sends duplicates. Redesign it for 25,000 rows.
evals.expected_output: A batch and continuation design with stable idempotency keys, checkpointing, bounded retries, overlap protection, safe logging, trigger ownership, and recovery controls.

evals.prompt: Our installable onFormSubmit trigger sometimes fails after the owner changes teams. Diagnose the ownership and authorization model and make setup reproducible.
evals.expected_output: An ownership-aware diagnosis, idempotent setup/cleanup functions, required scopes, reauthorization steps, duplicate handling, and operational documentation.
